essence: A localized elliptical displacement that simulates a magnifying lens or a pinch by shifting pixels toward or away from a center point. It uses an ellipsoid boundary to define the area of influence, where a height parameter determines the intensity and direction of the distortion.
manifests_as: A spherical or elliptical bulge/pinch within a specific region that preserves the original image outside its radii.

key_levers.name: Horizontal Radius
key_levers.effect: Sets the width of the distortion field; zeroing this effectively disables the effect along the X axis.

key_levers.name: Vertical Radius
key_levers.effect: Sets the height of the distortion field; the ratio between Horizontal and Vertical Radius determines the shape of the 'lens'.

key_levers.name: Bulge Center
key_levers.effect: The focal point of the distortion; moving this shifts where the magnification or pinch occurs on the layer.

key_levers.name: Bulge Height
key_levers.effect: The primary intensity lever. Positive values (0 to 4) expand the image outward (bloat); negative values (0 to -4) pull the image inward (pinch).

key_levers.name: Taper Radius
key_levers.effect: Determines the falloff at the edges of the radii; higher values create a smoother, more gradual transition into the undistorted areas of the image.

enums_to_verify.Antialiasing (ADBE Bulge-0006, 1-2): 1 is likely Low/None, 2 is likely High (Best Quality).
enums_to_verify.Pinning (ADBE Bulge-0007, 0-1): 0 is likely Off, 1 is likely On (pins edges of the layer to prevent the distortion from pulling in transparency).

config_recipes.Magnifying Glass: Bulge Height: 1.5, Taper Radius: 10, Radii: matched to lens size
config_recipes.Wide Angle Fisheye: Bulge Height: 2.0, Radii: Large (e.g., 500+), Taper Radius: 100

reasoning_hooks: The effect is completely invisible if either Radius is set to 0, regardless of the Bulge Height.
Negative 'Bulge Height' values functionally invert the effect, turning a magnification bubble into a black-hole-like pinch.
Unlike 'Spherize', Bulge allows for non-uniform (elliptical) scaling by decoupling Horizontal and Vertical radii.
High 'Bulge Height' values can cause extreme pixel stretching; the Antialiasing lever [ADBE Bulge-0006] must be at 2 for final renders to avoid aliasing artifacts.
grounding: matchNames verified against a live introspection of this build (9 settable params); levers the model proposed that do not exist or are not settable were dropped
_method: introspect/make_shallow_card.mjs — live introspection + model causal knowledge, mechanically grounded
